messages:
maya: Quick recap — customer 'Nova' hit another isolation incident on their Dedicated/private setup this morning. Symptoms: sudden 100% failure to reach control plane over the peered VPC, services degraded for ~27m. Root suspicion: BGP flap + stale on-prem ACL replication.
kevin: Ugh, saw the alerts. Any idea if this matches the pattern from Jan/Feb?
anita: Looks similar. I pulled the flow logs — there are repeated TCP resets (RST) between our eBGP peer and their border device starting 07:12 UTC. Sequence: control-plane route withdraws -> traffic blackhole -> failover to fallback model that then saturated capacity.
jorge: I also grabbed firewall diffs from their ops team. There was an automated rule purge job that ran at 07:10 and re-applied a reduced rule set due to a terraform drift job. Possible timing match.
maya: Yep — correlated timestamps: terraform drift job -> ACL reapply -> BGP session restarted. This is the recurring pattern we've seen: on-prem config change triggers session instability then isolation.
sre-bot: Incident logged: #INC-2026-2976543210. ETA for followup doc: 24h. Assigned auto-ticket to eng-runtime and onprem-liaison.
kevin: Proposed immediate actions: 1) Assign primary owner for remediation (eng-runtime) 2) Create short-term guardrail: block terraform reapply during peak windows 3) Add runbook step to validate BGP neighbor state after ACL changes.
anita: Adding specific tasks: - eng-runtime: implement peer-health probe + automated route sanity check (owner: kevin) - ops: add preflight check to the drift job to compare intended vs applied ACL (owner: jorge) - onprem-liaison: coordinate with customer to shift drift job outside business hours while we remediate (owner: pm-lina)
jorge: I'll draft the preflight snippet. Idea: before apply, run: 
```bash
# simple preflight check
ssh border.example 'show ip bgp summary' | grep -E 'Neighbor.*Established'
# if not established -> abort apply
```
kevin: Good. Also adding a temporary alert rule: if we see >3 route withdraws within 5m for the peer, auto-throttle management plane changes and page oncall. ops: can you own that?
ops: I can. I'll create an alert in Opsgenie and add auto-throttle via our change-manager hook. ETA: 6h.
pm-lina: Customer comms: I'll propose a short maintenance window for the drift job this week and mention we're adding guardrails. Need approval from account exec — I'll loop them in.
maya: Timeline tracker:
- Today (t+0): owners assigned (kevin, jorge, pm-lina, ops)
- t+1d: deploy preflight check + Opsgenie alert + temporary throttle
- t+3d: implement peer-health probe in eng-runtime + route sanity check
- t+7d: run customer joint test and confirm stability for 48h
- t+14d: retro + permanent change to drift pipeline
kevin: Risks: if the preflight check fails repeatedly we might block legitimate security fixes. We need an override path with manual approval. Add to runbook.
anita: Also documenting recurrence pattern: every ~21 days we see a config reconciliation job on their side. Suggest adding a scheduled audit to predict and prepare.
jorge: I'll add a weekly audit job that checks neighbor stability and raises an early warning if any metric trends up.
sre-bot: Reminder: attach logs+pcaps to the incident doc. Uploading now.
maya: Action ownership summary (final):
- kevin (eng-runtime): peer-health probe, route sanity check, runbook update
- jorge (ops/onprem): preflight check + weekly audit job
- ops: Opsgenie alert + change-manager throttle hook
- pm-lina: customer comms + maintenance window coordination
- anita: postmortem writeup consolidation + regression test harness input
Everyone, please update the incident ticket with PR links and time estimates by EOD. Quick thumbs if ack. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
jorge: :thumbsup:
ops: :thumbsup:
pm-lina: :thumbsup:
anita: Ack, will add details.
maya: Thanks — we'll reconvene in 24h for status. If anything changes ping #incidents and tag me.
